is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus group and Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes (page 2, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Rdl A296S (page 3, 7) and GSTe2 L119F (page 3, 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 7 states: 'Genotyping of 38 field-collected females detected the 296S RDL-resistant allele... at a frequency of 10.5 %'. Page 6 states: 'All 40 F0 and 40 F1 (20 DDT resistant and 20 susceptible) mosquitoes genotyped were homozygous for the susceptible L119 allele'.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Chikwawa district, southern Malawi (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field collections and molecular analysis.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection in 2014 and compares it to a 2009 sample.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles funestus in Chikwawa, Malawi, in 2014. It reports high resistance to pyrethroids and carbamates, and the first detection of the Rdl A296S mutation in southern African An. funestus. The L119F-GSTe2 mutation was not found.
